summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of BuyAnywhere Auto module. 35/36 backend pytest tests pass (1 false failure caused by pytest-xdist parallel ordering — not a code bug). All critical flows verified: auth, vehicle catalog/filters, price-breakdown formula (16233 NZD matches spec), deposit gate, bid happy path + outbid, equal-bid rejection (Russian msg), AU bidding disabled, watchlist toggle, inquiry (anon + auth), manual deposit upload + admin verify -> client2 can bid, admin CRUD on vehicles, AI translate, AI summary, importer from text and invalid URL, legacy /api/ and /api/currency-info. Frontend: /auto landing, catalog (12 cards), vehicle detail (title/price/breakdown render), dashboard logged-out, client dashboard ('Депозит подтверждён' badge), client2 dashboard with deposit-upload-form, admin panel rendering, Russian dark theme present.

minor.issue: When pytest runs in parallel (-n auto from pytest.ini), the deposit-gate test for client2 can fail after a sibling test has already verified client2's deposit. The deposit gate itself is implemented correctly (deposit check is before bid-amount check in auto_service.place_bid). Re-running serially or fixing test ordering would resolve.

integration_issues.issue: Typing in 'filter-search' does not auto-filter results; user must click 'Применить' (filter-apply-btn). The original test spec assumed live search. Either acceptable UX or update spec. Not a bug per se.

issues: Some vehicle cards show 'Нет изображения' placeholder text overlapping with the image (seed data has image_url that doesn't render — e.g. Toyota Hilux thumbnail shows broken/overlapping label). Cosmetic.

Default open tab is 'Автомобили'; 'admin-deposits-table' is only mounted when the user clicks the 'Депозиты' tab. Spec said admin-deposits-table should render immediately. Either change default tab to Deposits or document this. Functionally works after one click.

action_items: Optional: in /app/backend/pytest.ini, drop the -n auto for this suite OR add @pytest.mark.serial to deposit-gate tests so client2's deposit is exercised before parallel verify. Behavior is correct; only the test isolation is fragile.
Optional: auto-apply catalog filters on debounce instead of requiring an 'Применить' click for better UX consistency with the test plan.
Optional: open AutoAdmin on the 'Депозиты' tab by default OR render admin-deposits-table unconditionally so the test selector resolves without a tab click.
critical_code_review_comments: auto_routes.py is 693 lines — consider splitting into public/client/admin sub-routers for maintainability.
Stripe Checkout integration uses emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout — error path raises 500 with raw exception message; should sanitize before returning to client.
place_bid correctly checks user_has_verified_auto_deposit BEFORE validating bid amount (good).
All Mongo reads pop('_id') consistently — good.
Inquiry payload truncates message to 4000 chars — good defensive coding.
Frontend autoApi.js uses localStorage 'access_token' — confirmed working with existing AuthContext token (same key).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all critical flows verified; 2 minor UX observations)

seed_data_creation: Tests created 2 'TEST'-prefixed vehicles via admin import (one via import-from-text save=true, one via admin/vehicles CRUD which is then soft-deleted by status='hidden'). client2's deposit was promoted to 'verified' during the deposit-flow test. Re-running seed_auto.py would reset state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_auto_backend.py runs the full Auto suite. Note pytest.ini already configures -n auto (parallel) — the deposit-gate test for client2 is order-sensitive because once client2 is verified, the gate test cannot be re-exercised without DB reset. Run seed_auto.py before re-running if you need a fully clean state, or add @pytest.mark.serial. Frontend admin tab default is 'Автомобили'; click 'Депозиты' to see admin-deposits-table.
rca of the issue: Single backend test (TestBidding.test_bid_requires_deposit_client2) returns 400 instead of 403 when scheduled after TestDepositFlow.test_admin_verify_deposit due to pytest-xdist scheduling. Root cause: client2 deposit is already 'verified' in DB by the time the gate test runs, so place_bid skips the deposit check and falls through to amount validation (which returns 400 because 9000 < current highest). Code is correct; fix is test isolation: pin test order or seed-reset DB between runs.
